articleTitle: About increasing of duration of stable existence of objects
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility to vary term of life of objects at changing of constituents of their impedance is declared. The real capability to influence on the fixed impedance of the object is grounded.

articleTitle: Two-waveguide-based measurement of liquid level
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A principle for measuring a liquid level in a vessel is proposed. It is based on using two waveguides of different length and with different oscillating frequencies and is expected to provide high measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Investigation of current take-off characteristic in triode system with virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper a new triode circuit with virtual cathode was investigated. Such device has additional cathode grid and allows increasing an anode mutual conductance up to 100 mA/V.

articleTitle: Possibility of application wavelet-function Gauss the second order for approximation of the longitudinal distributions of the magnetic field of various types MPFS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article possibility of approximation of longitudinal distribution of a magnetic field in polyharmonious magnetic periodic focusing systems (MPFS) by means of two or three identical wavelet-functions Gauss the second order is considered.

articleTitle: Modelling of dna sequencing process by cellular automaton
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The technique of DNA sequencing modeling is presented. The two-dimensional model based on the probable cellular automaton is described.

articleTitle: Prospects for application of field emission structures as the current sources of powerful O-type devices
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of the use of planar-edge field emission structures for development of electron-optical systems of high-power O-type microwave devices is discussed, the results of theoretical and experimental analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Value estimation coupling of doublets resonator systems magnetron MM-range with loading
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Demonstrated presence of coupling of both doublets of oscillation mode resonator systems magnetron mm-range with loading. Possibility use of value of external quality factor as criterion of coupling of everyone from these doublets with an energy output of the device is considered.

articleTitle: Features of slow electromagnetic waves in biology and medicine application
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The development and realization of the microwave radiators, based on slow-wave structures (SWS) application, has shown that the application of slow electromagnetic waves is extremely promising in different areas of biology and medicine. This paper, based on analysis of the physical properties of slow electromagnetic waves and the lows of electrodynamics, presents the main features of SWS-based applicators and radiators which enable new applications of radiofrequency and microwave in biology and medicine.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic analysis of rectangular waveguides with L-Shaped Septa
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The methods of electrodynamics calculation and PC modeling of the electromagnetic field structure of TE- and TM-waves are derived. The problem is solved by the method of partial regions including field singularity at the edge. Using this program modules we can modeling on the PC electromagnetic field structure of TE- and TM-waves in three types of waveguides: Rectangular Waveguide with Two L-Shaped Septa, Rectangular Waveguide with Two Antipodal L-Shaped Septa, Rectangular Waveguide with four L-Shaped Septa. The cutoff wave numbers, the electromagnetic field structures of different types of TE- and TM waves of the waveguide are calculated.

articleTitle: Dependence of surface resistivity on the thickness of vanadium films
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Was studied dependence of the resistivity of the film of vanadium on its thickness. The aim was to film spraying of vanadium thickness of several tens of nanometers. Control of the thickness of deposited films of vanadium was carried out using the resistive method.

articleTitle: Wideband klystron high-power amplifiers for deep space communication systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A 13-kW, 80-MHz bandwidth X-band klystron high power amplifier (HPA) with double -gap cavities on input and on output resonance systems is investigated, using computations based on experimental performance data.

articleTitle: The analysis of dispersion characteristics of slow-wave systems of CIS type near TNE pass-through band BRDER
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The electrodynamicaly approved choice of resonator slow-wave system model which is equally suitable for describing the electrodynamic characteristics and excitation by given current was made. The possibility of calculation of electrodynamic characteristics of resonator slow-wave systems based on 3-d modeling results is shown. The results of the calculatuion of electrodynamic characteristics for slow-wave systems with two and four ports are given.

articleTitle: The analysis fraktal characteristics of microscopic objects with WTMM method application
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Article is devoted to research of fractal characteristics of microscopic objects with WTMM method application. The assessment of multifractal of studied images of surfaces is carried out.

articleTitle: The matrix field-emission structures based on carbon nanotubes for flat-panel displays
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The synthesis of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) in the holes was carried out by TCVD-method with using metal Fe-catalyst. The holes of depth of ∼ 7 µm were obtained in the tripartite structure Si/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Cr by means of conventional photolithography. The matrix period is 25 µm, the area of each square «window» in the layer of Cr is 100 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The field-emission current density of 26 µA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was registered at applied electric field of 4 − 5 V/µm. Such structures will be used to create matrix cathodes for field-emission displays.

articleTitle: Primary program processing of results of measurements after analog-digital transformation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article describes one possible method of pre-processing the data after it is satisfied the analog-digital conversion.

articleTitle: Nickel nanoparticles influence on the electrical properties of porous silicon obtained by the no-current electroless etching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Nickel nanoparticles influence on the electrical properties of porous silicon obtained by the no-current electroless etching are investigated.

articleTitle: Investigating the effect of biologically active environments and water on various modifications of silicon
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The effect of biologically active environments and water on various modifications of silicon are investigated.

articleTitle: Modeling of microwave devices for heat treatment of dielectric rod-shaped materials
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The comparative analysis of computer modelling and experimental investigations results for temperature distribution in dielectric rod-shaped materials are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of complicated microwave devices by RFS code
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A computer code RFS (Radio Frequency Simulator) is described. The code is based on vector finite element method and designated for analysis and optimization of complicated microwave devises and structures. The code RFS has advanced graphical user interface for creation, editing and importing geometrical models, unique mesh generator and power solver with capability of parallelization and calculation on a remote work station. Calculation results are displayed as surface and volume field distribution, S-parameters and VSWR graphs, Smith charts and 2-D and 3-D directivity charts.

articleTitle: Model of PV panel as part of combined power systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Is described an approach to modeling of photovoltaic panels in the combined power supply systems

articleTitle: One of the variants of reorganization of structure of the power supply of induction installation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article one of methods of use of multibuilding block systems for induction melting of metals is described, features of their operation on the basis of the three-modular independent bridge inverter are specified.

articleTitle: Clinotron effect in the amplification regimeon the following-traveling wave
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Clinotron effect in the amplification regime on the following-traveling wave was analysed. Numerical computation results show that clinotron effect improves the interaction efficiency in the system electron beam-following-traveling wave.

articleTitle: The calculate loading high quality of countours and resonators, that satisfy to law maintan order of power
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In preceding articles of author was shown, that generally expression of high quality is not satisfy to the low of the conservation of energy. In here develop a new presentation that conception and circumscribed the pass from old to new expression high quality.

articleTitle: Complex dielectric function of iron-containing polymeric composite nanomaterials in the range of 2–18 GHz
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Dielectric behavior (complex permittivity and loss) of iron-containing (5–20 wt.%) polymeric composite nanomaterials are investigated in the range from 2 to 18 GHz.

articleTitle: Model of the control system of rectifiers at parallel operation of generators on the tyre of the direct current
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Demanded quality of the electric energy developed by independent power plant, is provided with the offered scheme of management of rectifiers. Generators work in parallel for the general tire of a direct current. The scheme allows to provide uniform proportional loading of generators on size of loading and to have necessary voltage on conclusions of rectifiers.

articleTitle: System approach in organization of power supply of computer and computer systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A system approach to optimization of the energy efficiency of non-linear power supplies, as which the switching power supplies of computers were used, is described. The organization of power supply is based on sharing of the optical non-contact sensor, built-in functions of basic input-output system, power factor corrector in the pulsed power supply. The results of modeling in Matlab + Simulink are showed.

articleTitle: Decrease of a gain change in a broadband K-Ka TWT
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The output characteristics of the broadband K-Ka TWT are commutated. For the purpose of diminishing the gain variation (by the method, described in [1, 2]), a stop-band is introduced at the centre of the operating frequency range by a periodical change of the delay line pitch up to greater or lesser values about its initial value over a same region of an interaction space. According to the performed computation, the gain variation of the considered tube is diminished due to this measure from 23 to 10 dB, and the output power is change very insignificantly.

articleTitle: Modeling of the processes of electron-wave interaction in magnetron generator with regard to the influence of the locking signal
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The presented model with account of the influence of the locking signal on the processes of electron-wave interaction in magnetron generator. This feature allows assessing the influence of the design of the magnetron and the locking signal on the electrodynamics characteristics of a magnetron.

articleTitle: Slow-wave structure “longitudinally-connected rings” with small periodisity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A novel slow-wave structure (SWS) formed by longitudinally connected rings is offered and investigated in this paper. It is shown that provided by the offered structure slowing down (deceleration) does not depend significantly on the period and is much less than in the case of the helix with the same radius and period. In the same time, the dispersion property of the offered structure insufficiently differs from that of the helix. The deceleration dependence on frequency is relatively flat and such SWS can be used in the wideband TWTs instead of the helix. Due to a relatively small deceleration, the operating voltage of TWTs can be significantly increased without the backward wave oscillation at minus first spatial harmonic. This leads in turn to the significant increase in the operating current and the output power, as well as in possibility to increase the operating frequency.

articleTitle: Creation and investigation of multilayer structures based on Alq3
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The technology of producing the thin films of conjugated polymer coatings based on tris-(8-hydroxyquinoline) aluminum (Alq3) by the spray and spin-coating methods on a solid substrate was developed and optimized. The optimal mode and conditions of the producing, in which the thickness of the coatings are in the range of 100 nm, was founded. The multi-layer sandwich diode structure was created.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of the electron gun with low-perveance for THZ vacuum electronic power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The simulation results of low-perveance electron gun with the influence of the initial thermal velocity and a linear compression of 12 units is performed. It is shown that at an accelerating voltage of 20kV and an unipolar induction of a magnetic field of 1,175T the average current density in the beam is j = 327 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The simulation results of convergent sheet beam electron gun is presented as well.

articleTitle: The slowing systems fabrication based on alumina and polymeric media
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The construction of the slowing structures with using the polymeric current - carrying structures in integrated circuits is described. The configuration of the section relief of integrated circuits is based on the method of vertically through micro profiles. The vertically through micro profiles makes the vertically through micro cavities. Such architecture of integrated of electromagnetic fields in micro cavities without touching the dielectric carrier.

articleTitle: Techniques of the oscillatory system technological parameters express control on a low level capacity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Intermediate operations methods of the magnetron oscillatory system electro-dynamic parameters express control are stated. Operations introduction in technological process of magnetron manufacturing does not demand additional equipment and allows to withdraw technological spoilage in due time from production.

articleTitle: Sensors of magnetic field based on magnetoresistive effect
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article describes sensors of magnetic field based on magnetoresistive effect. Learning magnetoresistive effect is actually scientific research work now. Magnetoresistive sensors on ferromagnetic structures are divided into Anisotropic Magnetoresistor (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistor (GMR), Spin-Dependent Tunneling (SDT) Magnetoresistor. Using GMR and SDT sensors perspective to create highly sensitive and integrated measuring electronic devices.

articleTitle: Influence of the three-dimensional magnetic fields structure on intense electron beam transport
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Investigation of the influence of the focusing field sturcture against the pole piece magnetic saturation on electron beam transport is performed.

articleTitle: Propagation of plasmon waves in layer metal-dielectric structures with round cross section
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the report studies plasmon waves, that spreads in a layered metal-dielectric waveguides with a circular cross section and at they lie with frequencies in the terahertz range. The results of the effective refractive index calculated for the plasmon waves, that localized near the metal-insulator transition when geometrical parameters of the structure were changed. The results of calculations compare with results of the same characteristics of the finite element method.

articleTitle: Transverse magnetic field as a factor defining arc motion speed in vacuum interrupters
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The nonlinear character displayed by the vacuum arc current-voltage curve is shown to be responsible for an abrupt change of the constricted arc column speed over vacuum interrupter transverse magnetic field contacts.

articleTitle: New radioelectronic principles of low intensity infrared diagnostics of living tissues with micro- and nanoinhomogeneity includes
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the wavelength range from 1,4 to 14,5 micron spectrum is obtained by the inverse scattering of the IR layer of postoperative blood serum, adipose tissue layer, a layer of tumor tissue of breast cancer, limited plates of sapphire and silicon compensated, leading to an increase in the inverse scattering of the IR. For the first time experimentally investigated the effect of static magnetic and electric fields on the IR transparency of the living tissues. The experiments allow coming to an explanation of some features of the transmission and scattering of low-intensity infrared radiation in biological tissues was first discovered by the authors. The results open the way to the development of new electronic principles of low-intensity infrared diagnostics of living tissues and build on their base of highly non-invasive methods and devices for medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Prospects for increasing the power output vacuum microwave amplifiers Ka band
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Theoretical analysis of multi section Ka band TWT on CC is presented.

articleTitle: The technique and program for calculating of the microwave active oscillatore with electrostatic control
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The technique of modeling of the microwave multibeams devices of a cylindrical design with electrostatic control of a current is presented. Modeling of the microwave powerful tetrode generator of a UHF-band is carried out.

articleTitle: Transforming qualities of a delay system of the straight wave amplifier of M-type
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Proposed equivalent circuit of extreme slowing of cell amplifier of the direct wave of M-type transformers act as resistance. The expediency of its use in the analysis transforming their properties which takes place in dealing with harmonization of the energy output of this device.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of the longitudinal distributions of the magnetic field in the magnetic periodic focusing systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article creation of mathematical model of longitudinal distribution of a magnetic field in magnetic periodic focusing systems (MPFS) on the basis of mathematical models of separate ring constant magnets and size of the period of MPFS is described.

articleTitle: The numerical and experimental study of lengthy electron beam structure with microperveance 1,1 mkA/V3/2
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The computer-aided design of TWTO electron-optical system is carried out. The numerical and experimental study of lengthy electron beam structure of quasi-hollow and quasi-table forms is fulfilled. The results of the numerical study of electron beam structure correspond to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Simulation powerful TWT with stopband section of SWS with a use of theory of discrete electron-wave interaction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the study presents an approach to the modeling power TWT with stopband sections on the basis of the theory of discrete electron-wave interaction. Designed TWT without the use of equivalent circuits of SWS and with use of local coupling impedance and the characteristic equation of degree four.

articleTitle: The equivalent circuit of helix slow wave structure with simultaneous consideration of the forward and backward spatial harmonics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This report includes an examination of the equivalent circuit, consisting of capacitance and inductance, used for the approximation of the propagation of electromagnetic waves in slow-wave structure simultaneously the forward and backward harmonics; comparison of the dispersion curves of both actual slow-wave structure and equivalent circuit; the estimation of the parameters of the equivalent circuit according to a numerical modeling with three-dimensional computer code.

articleTitle: LED module corresponding standard light
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibilities of obtaining CRI LED devices above 90 by simulating the spectra of standard daylight sources and Planckian radiators are analized.

articleTitle: The influence of NiSO4 saturation on the electrophysical mesoporous silicon layers obtained by electrochemical method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The influence of NiSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> saturation on the electrophysical mesoporous silicon layers obtained by electrochemical method are investigated.

articleTitle: Multiple beam electron guns with gated electrode and carbon nanotube cathode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper we present the method to produce the multiple beam field-emission structure with cylindrical projections made from glassy carbon and coated with thin film of carbon nanotubes. The design of the 7-beam cathode-gate unit consisting of a flat field emission cathode with metal film gate on insulating substrate and 19-beam field emission electron gun with beam compression is performed. It is shown experimentally on a model 7-beam gun that achieved the level of current density of 2,8 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, for 19-beam gun - 12 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> on cathode.

articleTitle: Electrical properties of low-temperature plasma in a strong magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A study of the transverse concentration in a strongly magnetized gas discharge plasma. It is shown that in a strong magnetic field, the discharge may have a layered structure.

articleTitle: Using wavelet function gauss second level for modeling of magnetic systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this article provides an example of the wavelet functions of Gauss second-order modeling of magnetic systems. There present plots of the magnetic field distribution a selection of thickness of the magnet, of the ratio D / d, when the inner diameter, the dependence of the modulus square of the longitudinal distribution from the external diameter D, calculated on the basis of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Memristor structures based on tunnel-thin organic dielectric and porous silicon layers
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Memristor structures based on tunnel-thin organic dielectric and porous silicon layers are investigated.

articleTitle: About features of the 4-MM wavelength range coaxial magentron designing
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Features of the 4-mm wavelength range coaxial magnetron designing depending on target capacity level are considered.

articleTitle: Arc plasma synthesis of iron nanoparticles: Morphological, dielectric and magnetic characterization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Arc plasma synthesis of iron nanoparticles: morphological, dielectric and magnetic characterization are discussed.

articleTitle: Automated system for the measurement of thermal impedance components of semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article presents a system for measuring the components of the thermal impedance of semiconductor devices. The principle of operation is based on the heating device polyharmonic power, generated PWM and measures the response to this action - the variable component of the temperature, p-n junction.

articleTitle: Microwave electrovacuum Klystron's devices with multi-mode cavities
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The most important mode of operation for modern microwave electro vacuum klystron's devices is multi-mode when interaction between electrons and microwave field occurs not only on basic mode but on the multiple frequencies also.

articleTitle: The diffraction of magnetostatic waves by a slit in layered structures that include ferrite film
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The layered structure that includes magnetized ferrite film, dielectric and metal shield with the slit is considered. The components of magnetic field which is excited when the magnetostatic waves diffracts by a slit in the case of tangentially and normally magnetized ferrite film is defined.

articleTitle: Method of measuring conversion of parameters of sensors using time inversion of signals
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a digital method of conversion of the sensor and its hardware implementation. The method is based on excitation of oscillations in the sensitive elements of sensors, analog-digital conversion of signals and their time reversal by re-indexing of array elements, followed by Fourier transformation and determination of the initial phases of the oscillations.

articleTitle: Spectral composition of welding current and efficiency of welding inverter
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: On the basis of a computer model of the welding inverter with PWM control output impulses of alternating current the spectral composition of this current and its relation to efficiency at different values of operating frequency and duty cycle were investigate.

articleTitle: Dominant mode eigen wavelengths of the reentrant cavity resonator with inhomogeneous dielectric filling
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Reentrant cavity resonator partially loaded with dielectric is analyzed numerically using finite element method and commercial software HFSS. The lowest mode resonant wavelengths are calculated for different values of dielectric permittivity and sizes of the insert in capacitance gap. Obtained data can be used in computer-aided design of various microwave devices on the reentrant resonator.

articleTitle: Measuring of tissue's impedance for radiofrequency ablation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Device for measuring of the impedance was created which can be incorporated into any radiofrequency generator and measures resistance of heated tissues of biological objects during it's ablation.

articleTitle: Measurment module, based on uncooled bolometer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Measurement module was developed to measure the energy and power of laser radiation with a wavelength of 0.5-12 microns. It includes an uncooled bolometer based on VOx and the electrical circuit for processing the data. This module provides an independent measurement with a frequency of 1 MHz and 8-bit ADC. It can be used in industry and research.

articleTitle: Dielectric materials' micriwave thermal treatment modelling using different types of radiators
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The comparative analysis of computer modeling and experimental investigations results for temperature distribution in dielectric materials using different types of radiators are presented.

articleTitle: Problems of creation of flexible electromagnetic screens with a given levels of reflection and absorption
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Problems of creation of the easy, flexible, air-penetrable, cheap and technological screens, having a high degree of shielding and the given level of reflection are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of transient processes in electrical supply systems of magnetrons of low-power
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: For calculation the parameters of power supply systems need a model which allows to describing the magnetron as a load. At present there are simple models that are designed for calculation the power supplies in the steady state. A model of the magnetron in the form of two mutually influencing two-terminal networks with variable parameters, which allows us to study the static and dynamic processes in the power supply systems of various schemes, is described.

articleTitle: Simulation and experimental investigation of electronoptical system for pulsed power helical TWT
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The report presents numerical simulations of an electron beam produced by the electron optical system of a pulse TWT, and compares them with experimental measurements of the electron-beam transmission efficiency in the device model.

articleTitle: Investigation of dynamic properties of precise temperature regulation of resonator system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The mathematical models and software systems for the analysis of high-precision thermal stabilization of resonators based on bulk acoustic waves, taking into account non-stationary thermal processes are developed. A comparative analysis of the dynamic properties of thermal stabilization of various types and assesses their effectiveness are made.

articleTitle: Mobile handset antenna frequency band enlarging
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A method of enlarging mobile handset antenna frequency band is described. The method uses a matching series LC circuit to compensate reactance of the antenna impedance on the borders of the frequency band. Parameters of the LC circuit are determined using results of antenna simulation by the computer RFS code. The method allows to widen antenna's frequency band nearly twice.

articleTitle: Calculation of permissible current load cables in corrugated cotduits, with inclusion of higher harmonics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article describes the features of calculation of the thermal regime of cables laid in a double-wall corrugated polyethylene smooth and thick-walled tubes with different diameters of cable ways and pipes, in which revealed a significant dependence of the allowable current ratio of the diameters of cable from the cable and pipe.

articleTitle: Modified algorithm of tomographic image reconstruction based on TV-minimisation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The paper considers the algorithm for image reconstruction for tomographic microscopy applications

articleTitle: Some features of the processes in the circuit breaker based on vacuum interrupter chamber
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This report summarizes the results obtained in switching on vacuum arcs and related problems.

articleTitle: Reduction of heterogeneity longitudinal component of the electrical field in the output cavity of multibeam klystrons
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The paper presents results of research double-gap cavity formed by the penultimate and last resonators of multibeam klystron. It is shown that the amplitude of the longitudinal components of the electric field in the gaps of the double-gap cavity differ significantly, when coupling slot is rectangular. Reduce the difference in the amplitudes was using a Π-shaped coupling slot.

articleTitle: Automated setup for investigation of the semiconductor structures electrophysical properties
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: An automated setup for investigation of the semiconductor structures electrophysical properties is described. The design, the scheme of connection with a computer, and software of the setup are described. The test measurements were done and results are presented.

articleTitle: Correlative-impulse measuring instrument of low frequency noise sources of semiconductor devises
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The skeleton diagram of correlative-impulse measuring instrument of LF noise sources of semiconductor devises is shown. The principle of action of a measuring instrument for a case of measurements of diodes with Schottky barrier is considered. The reasons of inaccuracy of measurements are specified. The assessment of accuracy of correlation coefficient is given.

articleTitle: Simulation of LF noises FET in the program «Micro-Cap» in THE «Transient analysis» mode
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The model of the modulation LF noise source which allows to simulate noise in the «Micro-Cap» program in the «Transient analysis» mode is given. Results of simulation of the flicker noise of FET are shown, when using this noise source.

articleTitle: 1D-numerical model of the microwave drying dynamics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this paper we propose a simple one-dimensional phenomenological model of microwave dielectric drying, which allows to take into account the spatial distribution of water content and temperature into the dielectric object.

articleTitle: Fabrication of tunnel barrier by scanning probe lithography
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Atomic force microscope was used to fabricate nano oxide line crossing nickel microstructure. After oxidation current-voltage characteristics of the structure showed tunnel barrier behavior

articleTitle: Ways of improvement of microwave oscillators with medium transit angle over interaction area
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Ways of improvement of microwave oscillators, such as monotron, low-voltage vircator, retarding-field oscillator are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Computer code for investigation of linear regimes of operation in inhomogeneous broadband helix TWT
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The report presents the results of design and testing the computer code, which is suitable for analysis the linear working regimes of broadband helix traveling wave tube with inhomogeneous slow wave structure. The calculation samples are described for the dependences between gain coefficient and voltage and frequency of the signal for varying currents of electronic beam. The conditions of the amplifier parasitic excitation via the reflections from the end of the device were investigated.

articleTitle: The vacuum state control in magnetron
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The technique of a residual gases pressure indirect estimation in an operational mode magnetron is resulted.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistive sensors on information-measuring and managing systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This article describes magnetoresistive sensors as components of information-measuring and managing systems. GMR and SDT sensors with processing logic are used to development modern high sensitivity systems for measuring, control and managing technological processes including medical researches.

articleTitle: High power wide band RF onboard amplifiers: Single unit or chain?
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The experimental and theoretical analysis of multi section TWT on CC is presented.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocity of surface magnetostatic waves in 1D magnonic crystals with non-symmetrical load
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the present work 1D magnonic crystal is considered. Such structures are similar to the photonic and acoustic crystals but formed on the basis of magnetic materials in which the magnetostatic waves can propagate. Due to the possibility of propagation of different types of waves these systems can be used in the different signal processing devices. In this work the study of dispersion, magnetic and electric field distribution in the primitive cell of periodical structure was provided. The nonreciprocity phenomena were investigated in detail for the structures with non-symmetrical load for the different distances between YIG film and metal shield.

articleTitle: Kinetics of atomic mechanisms of adsorption at the microwave vacuum - plasma deposition of submonolayer carbon coverings on silicon crystalss
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Dependences of density of insular nanoeducations on temperature of sedimentation of submonolayer carbon coverings on silicon (100) crystals in the microwave plasma of fumes ethanol after a preliminary micromachining of plates in CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> plasma and argon are investigated. It is established that after plasma micromachining in freon superficial density it is less, than after processing in argon, and they increase with temperature growth for freon and decreases for argon. It is shown that such nature of dependences testifies to existence of a precursor chemisorptions and is caused by various power of adsorption of carbon on the plates of the silicon which have passed preliminary micromachining in various chemically active environments.

articleTitle: Beam phase space influence on dynamical current interception and efficiency of high-power O-type amplifier
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Investigation of the influence of the focusing field profile on amplifier characteristics was performed with beam phase space took into account.

articleTitle: Theory of electron waves in periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: With the help of the difference theory of excitation of periodic waveguides obtained by the characteristic equation of the electron waves formed by the interaction of an electron beam with the forward and backward electromagnetic waves periodic waveguides. The resulting characteristic equation describes the electron-wave interaction in the passband and stopband of periodic waveguides and includes as special cases of well-known equation for the «smooth» slow-wave systems and resonator slowwave systems near the cutoff frequency. Found a number of analytical solutions of the characteristic equation, which allowed to compare the properties of the amplification and propagation of electron waves inside and on the border of passband and stopband of periodic waveguides.

articleTitle: Double-gap cavity with three multiple frequencies for multi- beam microwave electric vacuum devices
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A new type of a multy -mode double-gap cavity for multy-beam microwave klystron devices is developed. This cavity can to tune in three multiple frequencies - anti-phase at frequency f, in-phase one at frequency 2f and anti-phase one at frequency 3f. Such cavities can be useful in a high efficiency, compact power microwave electric vacuum devices.

articleTitle: Mathematical calculation microwave plasma reactor for nanoelectronics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The paper calculates the size and position of holes due to herpes feeding waveguide with a variable height of narrow wall and a cylindrical chamber with a view to more homogeneous plasma in a cylindrical chamber.

articleTitle: Electrophysical properties of nanostructures Al-SiMP-pSi-Al, passivated by iron
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The current-voltage and the current-capacitance characteristics of structures on the basis of mesoporous silicon received by nonelectrolitic method of etching at passivation by iron (SiMP:Fe) are investigated. It is shown, that in heterostructures Al-SiMP:Fe-pSi-Al conductivity and barriers depend on Fe concentration no monotonic.

articleTitle: Electronic conductivity of microwave frequency gap in regime of high amplitude voltage
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: It was demonstrated that active conductivity at variable voltage amplitude is greater than accelerating and it increases at shortened narrow gap.

articleTitle: Development of the methodology calculation of devices of Klystron type in self-consistent regime
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The methodology and equations for simulation klystron type devices are presented.

articleTitle: Mathematic modeling of tools for analysis and control of media containing core-shell nanoobjects
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Mathematic modeling of tools for analysis and control of media containing core-shell nanoobjects are discussed.

articleTitle: Research of transient processes in the inverter source for welding high-frequency alternating current
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: By force of computer and physical simulation of processes in the welding inverter received the dependences indicating influence of supply-line voltage, the reactivity of scheme and parameters of pre-blanking pulses on value of impulse overvoltage on inverter transistors.

articleTitle: Effect of reflection from the remote load on mode competition in a two-mode electronic maser
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Effect of reflection from the remote load on the mode competition in a two-mode electronic maser is considered. A system of two coupled equations for slowly varying amplitudes of the modes with time delayed coupling is investigated analytically and numerically. It is shown that the reflections can, under the certain conditions, strongly affect the operation regime. Complicated sequence of transitions from one regime to another which takes place with the increase of reflection factor is investigated.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic properties' investigation of chemisorption materials ≪POLYCON K≫ with introduced iron and nickel nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Electrodynamic properties' investigation of chemisorption materials "POLYCON K" with introduced iron and nickel nanoparticles are discussed.

articleTitle: Model of the dynamics of the process of metal cutting
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article describes a new approach to building models of the dynamics of the process of cutting. The proposed approach has allowed to get away from regenerative models with time delay, and, therefore, on an infinite-dimensional phase space. The proposed model of the dynamics of metal cutting process takes into account the variety of machining vibrations and eliminates the gross simplifications used in some traditional models.

articleTitle: Multielectrode bipolar coagulation system for tissue
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Claster consisting from four water-cooled electrodes arranged in a circle was developed and investigated impedance characteristics and heating of tissue's simulator.

articleTitle: Super high power pulsed klystrons and multifrequency microwave electrovacuum devices. Obtained performances, prospects of development
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The state of development of super high power klystrons is considered. It is shown that high power levels are achieved at the account of high anode voltages (200–500 kV). Proposed is the principle of obtaining super high pulsed powers with significantly reduced anode voltages thanks to placing single or multibeam klystrons with the magnetron gun in a common focusing solenoide with a uniform magnetic field as well as combining their output powers.

articleTitle: Analysis structure of the magnetic field in the special construction magnet
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this article discusses a study of the magnetic field in the magnet of special design. And also present graphs of the magnetic fields of the depth probe into the solenoid, as well as at various positions of the sensor gap between the pole shoes.

articleTitle: Universal controlled electronic load for tests of highvoltage instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of using of electron-beam valves of a type ЭЛВ 2/200 in the high-voltage device is offered to attention as a basic element of a controlled bipolar dynamic equivalent load for long-lived or short-lived test of high-voltage devices at voltage of any polarity up to 200 kVs, continuous currents up to 2 A, pulse up to 5 A, power of dissipation up to 400 kWs.

articleTitle: Interface of a measuring system on basis of a multiple-unit thermal sensor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Measurement module was developed to measure the energy and power of laser radiation with a wavelength of 0.5-12 microns. It includes an uncooled bolometer based on VOx and the electrical circuit for processing the data. This module provides an independent parallel measurement. It can be used in industry and research.
